docs.title: Commands
docs.text:
• mkdocs new [dir-name] - Create a new project.
  • mkdocs serve - Start the live-reloading docs server.
  • mkdocs build - Build the documentation site.
  • mkdocs -h - Print help message and exit.

docs.title: Project layout
docs.text:
mkdocs.yml    # The configuration file.
docs/
    index.md  # The documentation homepage.
    ...       # Other markdown pages, images and other files.

docs.title: Azure
docs.text: Commands specific to working with Azure cloud resources and identity services (US Government / GCC High)

docs.title: Connect to Microsoft Graph (US Gov)
docs.text:
Needed when managing Entra ID users, groups, and directory objects via Microsoft Graph.

Connect-MgGraph `
  -Scopes "Group.ReadWrite.All","Directory.AccessAsUser.All" `
  -Environment USGov

docs.title: Connect to Microsoft Graph (Read vs Read/Write)
docs.text:
Used when limiting Graph access to read-only or enabling write operations.

Connect-MgGraph -Scopes "User.Read.All","Group.Read.All" -Environment USGov

Connect-MgGraph -Scopes "User.ReadWrite.All","Group.ReadWrite.All" -Environment USGov

docs.title: AzureAD Module
docs.text:
Needed when performing legacy Entra ID operations not yet fully available in Microsoft Graph.

Install-Module -Name "AzureAD" -Force
Import-Module "AzureAD" -UseWindowsPowerShell

docs.title: Connect to Azure AD (US Gov)
docs.text:
Used for direct Azure AD authentication in GCC High.

Connect-AzureAD -AzureEnvironmentName AzureUSGovernment

docs.title: Exchange Online Management Module
docs.text:
Needed when administering Exchange Online mailboxes, permissions, and transport rules.

Install-Module -Name "ExchangeOnlineManagement" -Force
Import-Module "ExchangeOnlineManagement"

docs.title: Connect to Exchange Online (GCC High)
docs.text:
Used for managing Exchange Online in US Government tenants.

Connect-ExchangeOnline -ExchangeEnvironmentName O365USGovGCCHigh

docs.title: Microsoft Graph PowerShell SDK
docs.text:
Needed for all modern Azure / Entra ID management via Graph.

Install-Module -Name "Microsoft.Graph" -Force
Import-Module "Microsoft.Graph"

docs.title: Verify Graph Connection Context
docs.text:
Used to confirm tenant, environment, and granted scopes.

Get-MgContext

docs.title: Unblock Files
docs.text:
To unblock a singular file

unblock-file "PATH_TO_FILE"

To unblock all files recursively starting at initially provided path

Get-childitem "PATH_TO_FOLDER" | unblock-file

docs.title: Digital Sig. Check
docs.text:
Checks whether a file is digitally signed.

(Get-AuthenticodeSignature "PATH_TO_FILE").Status

docs.title: Zone-ID/MOTW:
docs.text:
This will return the source of the file:

Get-Content -Path "PATH_TO_FILE" -Stream Zone.Identifier

1 = Local Intranet 2 = Trusted Sites 3 = Internet 4 = Restricted

docs.title: Anaconda Information
docs.text:
Provides all configuration information about conda

conda info

docs.title: Environments:
docs.text:
Adds environment to GUI options

conda config --add envs_dirs C:\Apps\conda-envs

Create a new environment at location, then needs to be activated (Location and python version can be changed)

conda create -p C:\Apps\conda-envs\MyEnv python=3.11

conda activate C:\Apps\conda-envs\MyEnv
